question_text: A SaaS startup's monthly churn drops from 5% to 2.5% while ARPU stays constant at $100. What happens to Customer Lifetime Value (CLV = ARPU / Churn)?

game_config.clue_text: Plug the numbers into CLV = $100 / 0.05 ($2,000) vs. CLV = $100 / 0.025 ($4,000). Cutting churn in half divides the denominator by 2!
game_config.answer_explanation: Because churn sits in the denominator of the retention CLV formula (ARPU / c), halving churn from 5% to 2.5% exactly doubles Customer Lifetime Value from $2,000 to $4,000.
game_config.takeaway: Expected Value of Sample Information (EVSI): Buying research is only profitable when the accuracy lift outweighs the research cost!
